name: What kind of adhesive is used for loose tile repair?

mainEntity.name: What kind of adhesive is used for loose tile repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: For loose tile repair, the choice of adhesive largely depends on the tile type, subfloor material, and moisture exposure. Typically, a high-quality thin-set mortar is used, often a polymer-modified version for enhanced bond strength and flexibility. For areas prone to moisture, like bathrooms, a waterproof or moisture-resistant thin-set is crucial. Our contractors select the appropriate adhesive based on the specific conditions of your installation.
